newsitem.title: ITALY: Italcementi buying Compart unit in July.
newsitem.headline: Italcementi buying Compart unit in July.

text.p: Agri-chemical group company Compart will complete the sale of its Calcestruzzi unit to Italcementi by the end of July, Compart said in a statement on Friday.
The signing of a contract completing the sale of Calcestruzzi follows the go-ahead last month to the deal -- which was unveiled in February -- from Italy's anti-trust authority.
Compart's Calcemento Spa holding company will receive a "financial benefit" of nearly 500 billion lire, said the statement.

The transfer of 100 percent of Calcestruzzi's stock to the Italcementi group's Italcalcestruzzi subsidiary will take place on July 31. At the same time Compart will pay 18 billion lire to acquire from Italcalcestruzzi a 21.1 percent stake in Calfince Spa, a company with a 50.3 percent stake in Calcemento Spa.
